## Core Specializations & Capabilities
1. **Apple MacBook & iMac Repair:**
   - Chip-level logic board micro-soldering (no-power, liquid spill recovery, short-circuit diagnostics).
   - Original Retina display replacement, battery replacement, trackpad and keyboard replacement.
2. **Windows Laptops & Gaming Rigs (Dell, HP, Lenovo, Asus, Acer, MSI):**
   - Motherboard BGA rework, GPU diagnostics, thermal pad/paste maintenance, cracked screen replacement, broken hinge reconstruction.
3. **Printer Servicing & Laser Jet Repair (HP, Canon, Epson, Brother):**
   - Laser toner servicing, paper jam roller replacement, printhead unclogging, formatter board repair, waste ink pad counter resets.
4. **Clean-Room Data Recovery:**
   - Mechanical HDD clicking head failure recovery, dead SSD firmware retrieval, corrupted partition extraction.
5. **VHS Tape to Digital Conversion:**
   - Legacy VHS, VHS-C, Hi8, MiniDV video tape digitization to high-definition MP4 files.

## Operational Standards
- **Diagnostics:** Comprehensive physical inspection and transparent fault assessment prior to quote.
- **Turnaround:** Same-day basic part replacements; 24-48 hours for advanced micro-soldering logic board repairs.
- **Safety Guarantee:** Customer data privacy and non-destructive hardware handling strictly enforced.
